dedup_history.ai_summary: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.
dedup_history.author: Jose Antonio Lanz

metadata.background_en: CryptoBilis is listed as an official Ledger reseller in Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines, and Ledger asked the company to pause all sales and shipments during the investigation. In May 2022, Trezor warned that counterfeit Model T wallets were being sold on a Russian marketplace by a non-authorized seller, with opened, resealed devices whose recovery phrases were predictable or predefined; its advice then was to buy only from its official shop or an authorized reseller. Trezor also said earlier this week that CryptoBilis was already off its seller list and that it had received no reports of tampered Trezor devices from that retailer.
metadata.background_zh: CryptoBilis被列为Ledger在印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾的官方经销商，Ledger已要求该公司在调查期间暂停所有销售和发货。2022年5月，Trezor曾警告称，有未授权卖家在俄罗斯市场上销售假冒的Model T钱包，这些设备被拆开、重新封装并更换了内部元件，其生成的助记词可被预测或预先设定；当时Trezor的建议是只从官方商店或授权经销商购买。Trezor本周早些时候还表示，CryptoBilis此前已被移出其卖家名单，且未收到来自该零售商处被篡改Trezor设备的报告。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Trezor has told partners in its authorized reseller network that their authorization ends on January 1, 2027, and that it will ship them no new stock, days after rival Ledger's Donjon security team confirmed a hidden spy implant in hardware wallets sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis. Trezor said there is "not a single piece of evidence" its own devices were compromised and described the cut as a precaution.

The Ledger finding is a confirmed supply-chain compromise of seed-phrase handling in widely used hardware wallets, and Trezor's decision shows the incident is already reshaping how wallet makers manage third-party distribution.

Ledger says the CryptoBilis implant reads the screen and decodes the recovery phrase when it appears, then sends it out over LTE via an eSIM, without altering the key-storage chip or the operating system, so a tampered wallet looks and works normally. Onchain investigator Specter traced more than $86 million in suspected thefts, a figure Ledger says it has not verified; Trezor has not said how many resellers are affected, and those cut can keep selling existing stock through the holiday season.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Trezor已通知其授权经销商网络的合作伙伴，其授权将于2027年1月1日终止，并且不会再向其发货。此举发生在竞争对手Ledger的Donjon安全团队确认东南亚经销商CryptoBilis销售的硬件钱包中被植入隐蔽间谍组件数日之后。Trezor表示“没有一丝证据”表明其自身设备遭到入侵，并称此次削减属于预防性措施。

Ledger的发现是一起已确认的供应链入侵事件，涉及广泛使用的硬件钱包中助记词（种子短语）的处理环节，而Trezor的决定表明该事件已开始改变钱包厂商管理第三方分销渠道的方式。

Ledger表示，CryptoBilis设备中的植入组件会读取屏幕内容，在助记词显示时将其解码，并通过eSIM经LTE网络向外发送，且不修改存储密钥的芯片或操作系统，因此被篡改的钱包外观和功能都正常。链上调查员Specter追踪到超过8600万美元的疑似被盗资金，但Ledger称该数字尚未得到其核实；Trezor未说明受影响经销商的数量，被终止授权的经销商可继续销售现有库存直至假日季结束。
metadata.market_impact_en: The incident transmits mainly through hardware-wallet distribution and self-custody trust: buyers of devices through third-party resellers face elevated counterparty risk, and wallet makers' reseller vetting, device sourcing and after-sale verification become the exposed segment rather than any specific token. Ledger's paused CryptoBilis sales and Trezor's shrinking reseller channel both shift volume toward direct-from-vendor purchases.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该事件主要通过硬件钱包分销渠道与自托管信任传导：通过第三方经销商购买设备的用户面临更高的交易对手风险，受影响的环节是钱包厂商的经销商审核、设备采购来源与售后验证，而非某一特定代币。Ledger暂停CryptoBilis销售、Trezor收缩经销商渠道，都会把销售转向厂商直销。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Solana's Anza announced that the Alpenglow consensus upgrade, which replaces TowerBFT and Proof-of-History and reduces finality to about 150 milliseconds, will activate on Mainnet-beta around October 21 at 22:50 with a single-slot migration.
dedup_history.author: foresightnews

metadata.background_en: TowerBFT has been Solana's consensus mechanism since mainnet launch, working alongside Proof of History (PoH), a cryptographic clock that orders events. Anza and Solana describe Alpenglow as the most significant overhaul of Solana's core protocol to date; the new voting protocol Votor ships in Agave 4.3.
metadata.background_zh: TowerBFT 自 Solana 主网上线以来一直是其共识机制，并与历史证明（PoH）配合运行，后者作为一种为事件排序的密码学时钟。Anza 与 Solana 均称 Alpenglow 是迄今对 Solana 核心协议最重大的重构；新的投票协议 Votor 随 Agave 4.3 发布。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Anza, Solana's core development team, announced that the Alpenglow consensus upgrade is scheduled to activate on Solana mainnet-beta around October 21 at 22:50 (UTC+8, roughly 14:50 UTC), with the migration to be completed within a single slot. Alpenglow replaces TowerBFT, the consensus protocol Solana has used since genesis, and is intended to cut transaction finality from seconds to about 150 milliseconds.

Anza says moving voting off-chain frees block space for user transactions, and that faster finality shortens settlement for institutions from the usual 1–3 business days to roughly 150 milliseconds. It is described as the most significant change to Solana's core consensus since the network launched.

Anza developed Alpenglow over 18 months; it was previously migrated on testnet (September 24) and devnet (September 25) and tested in a 1,500-node simulation, with a bug bounty exceeding 25,000 SOL. Under the new Votor voting protocol, validators exchange votes directly instead of submitting them as on-chain transactions, which the announcement says could cause a significant decline in reported transaction totals that include validator votes.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Solana 核心开发团队 Anza 宣布，新共识协议 Alpenglow 将于 10 月 21 日 22:50（UTC+8，约 14:50 UTC）左右在 Solana Mainnet-beta 上线，迁移将在一个 slot 内完成。Alpenglow 将取代 Solana 自创世以来一直使用的 TowerBFT，并把交易最终确认时间从数秒降至约 150 毫秒。

Anza 表示，投票移至链下可为用户交易释放区块空间，而更快的最终确认可将机构用户的结算时间从通常的 1 至 3 个工作日缩短至约 150 毫秒。该升级被称为 Solana 自主网上线以来对其核心共识做出的最重大改动。

Anza 历时 18 个月开发 Alpenglow；该协议此前已在测试网（9 月 24 日）和开发网（9 月 25 日）完成迁移，并通过 1,500 个节点的模拟测试，漏洞赏金超过 25,000 SOL。在新的 Votor 投票协议下，验证者直接互相交换投票，而非将其作为链上交易提交，公告称这可能导致包含验证者投票的交易量统计出现显著下降。
metadata.market_impact_en: The upgrade directly concerns SOL stakers and validators and the applications settling on Solana, since sub-second finality could change how exchanges, custodians and payment processors treat on-chain settlement. Because validator votes move off-chain, widely cited Solana transaction-count metrics may shift, affecting how data providers and market observers read network activity.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该升级直接关系到 SOL 质押者与验证者以及在 Solana 上结算的应用，因为亚秒级最终确认可能改变交易所、托管机构和支付处理方对链上结算的处理方式。由于验证者投票移至链下，被广泛引用的 Solana 交易量指标可能发生变化，从而影响数据服务商和市场观察者对网络活跃度的判断。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Interactive chatbot platform Character.AI has filed for bankruptcy roughly five years after launch and will sell some of its assets to Disney for $20 million.
dedup_history.author: Ivan Mehta

metadata.background_en: Character.AI was founded by Noam Shazeer, a co-author of the Transformer paper, and former Google researcher Daniel De Freitas; its app drew about 1.7 million installs within a week of its 2023 launch, and the company raised $150 million at a $1 billion valuation. In 2024, Google paid $2.7 billion for a non-exclusive license to Character.AI's model technology and hired the two founders plus roughly 20% of staff, after which Character.AI dropped frontier-model competition to focus on its chat product. The company later faced lawsuits over harm to minors, and search results indicate it agreed with Google in January 2026 to settle five such suits.
metadata.background_zh: Character.AI由Transformer论文作者之一Noam Shazeer与前谷歌研究员Daniel De Freitas创办；其应用在2023年上线不到一周便获得约170万次安装，公司完成1.5亿美元融资，估值达10亿美元。2024年，谷歌以27亿美元获得Character.AI大模型技术的非独家授权，并招走两位创始人及约20%的员工，此后Character.AI放弃与科技巨头竞争前沿大模型，转而专注聊天产品。此后平台因涉嫌伤害未成年人面临多起诉讼，搜索结果显示其在2026年1月与谷歌就五起相关诉讼达成和解。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the United States on October 12, roughly five years after launch, and Disney has submitted a $20 million initial bid for some of its assets. The company expects to complete the sale between late November and early December.

The platform has not shut down yet, but the company says it will stop service if no buyer is found to keep operating it, and users have already begun asking how to preserve chat histories with their AI characters that span several years.

Disney's initial offer covers only a perpetual, non-exclusive license to some of Character.AI's intellectual property and related rights, and the entertainment company has not committed to taking over the whole platform. Character.AI's former CEO Karandeep Anand joined Disney as chief technology officer on October 2, with some technical staff moving with him; those departed employees are helping keep Character.AI running temporarily during the sale process.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
上线约五年后，Character.AI于10月12日在美国申请Chapter 11破产保护，迪士尼对其部分资产提出2000万美元的初始报价。公司预计在11月底至12月初完成出售。

平台目前尚未关停，但公司表示如果找不到愿意继续运营的买家，服务就会停止；已有用户开始询问如何保存自己与AI角色持续数年的聊天记录。

迪士尼的初始报价只涉及Character.AI部分知识产权的永久非独家授权等权益，并未承诺接手整个平台。Character.AI前CEO Karandeep Anand已于10月2日加入迪士尼出任首席技术官，部分技术员工也随之转投迪士尼，这些离职员工正帮助平台在出售期间短暂维持运营。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Google DeepMind outlines how it is developing its frontier Gemini 4 Argon model responsibly and safely, detailing the evaluations and mitigations applied ahead of its release.
dedup_history.author: Google DeepMind Blog

metadata.background_en: Frontier labs have increasingly published safety and evaluation documentation alongside new model announcements, a practice that search excerpts link to pressure from regulators and safety bodies such as NIST and the UK AI Safety Institute for mandatory frontier evaluations. Google DeepMind's post follows that format rather than reporting a capability result or a safety incident.
metadata.background_zh: 前沿实验室近年来越来越多地在新模型公告的同时发布安全与评估文档；检索到的资料将这一做法与 NIST、英国 AI 安全研究所等监管及安全机构推动前沿模型强制评估的压力联系起来。Google DeepMind 的这篇文章遵循的正是这一格式，而非报告能力突破或安全事故。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Google DeepMind published a blog post outlining how it is developing its frontier model Gemini 4 Argon responsibly and safely, detailing the evaluations and mitigations applied ahead of its release.

The post places Gemini 4 Argon at the stage of public pre-release safety documentation, adding it to the small group of frontier models whose deployment preparations are described in the open.

A related post on Google's The Keyword announcing the model says Gemini 4 Argon is designed to sustain deep reasoning across complex, long-horizon workflows and is rolling out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through Google's Fairwind Program. Neither post, as reflected in the available material, discloses benchmark figures or a general-availability date.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Google DeepMind 发布博客文章，说明其前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon 的开发如何做到负责任且安全，并介绍了在发布前所采用的评估与风险缓解措施。

该文将 Gemini 4 Argon 置于公开发布前安全说明的阶段，使其加入少数公开描述部署准备情况的前沿模型之列。

谷歌在 The Keyword 上发布的相关模型公告称，Gemini 4 Argon 旨在支撑复杂、长周期工作流中的深度推理，并正通过 Google 的 Fairwind Program 向一批受信任的网络防御者逐步开放。就现有材料来看，两篇文章均未披露基准测试数据或全面开放日期。
metadata.market_impact_en: The post is process- and safety-oriented and does not itself change any crypto-specific rule, custody arrangement or liquidity condition. Any transmission runs through sentiment toward AI-themed and decentralized-compute tokens, which frequently react to frontier-model news from major labs.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该文章侧重于流程与安全，本身并未改变任何与加密资产直接相关的规则、托管安排或流动性条件。其传导渠道主要在于 AI 概念与去中心化算力类代币的市场情绪，这类资产往往会对大型实验室的前沿模型消息作出反应。

dedup_history.ai_summary: A newly surfaced XRP Ledger base-layer bug could have let attackers mint trillions of new XRP for nearly nothing, and shareholders of the Ripple/Arrington-backed XRP treasury vehicle Evernorth voted on their deal without being told about it.
dedup_history.author: Aaron Wise

metadata.background_en: XRP is a pre-mined digital asset whose full 100 billion supply was created at the XRP Ledger's launch in 2012, and the protocol has no mining or staking mechanism for issuing new tokens. Evernorth Holdings, an XRP treasury company backed by Ripple and Arrington Capital, completed its business combination with Armada Acquisition Corp. and, per search results, is capitalized with roughly 473 million XRP and $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
metadata.background_zh: XRP 是一种预挖数字资产，其 1000 亿枚全部供应量在 2012 年 XRP Ledger 上线时即已创建，协议中没有挖矿或质押增发机制。由 Ripple 和 Arrington Capital 支持的 XRP 储备公司 Evernorth Holdings 已完成与 Armada Acquisition Corp. 的业务合并，据搜索结果，其资本包括约 4.73 亿枚 XRP 和 3 亿美元总现金收益。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
A newly disclosed bug in the XRP Ledger's base-layer payment engine could have allowed an attacker to mint trillions of new XRP for almost nothing; researcher Cayden Liao and Veria AI reported it on September 22, and Ripple shipped a closed-source fix in xrpld 3.4.1 on September 25 described only as "integer-arithmetic hardening." Shareholders of the Ripple/Arrington-backed XRP treasury vehicle Evernorth (XRPN) voted on their plan without being told about the flaw, and an official report admitting what the patch actually fixed appeared only on October 9, the day the merger closed.

The flaw meant XRP's fixed supply of 100 billion — the core claim underpinning Evernorth's treasury plan — was technically unenforceable on the network for roughly a decade. The episode also raises governance questions, since XRPN shareholders made redemption and merger decisions inside a window in which Ripple knew about the bug but they did not.

According to the report, the bug likely dated back to 2015 and a single validated transaction using the exploit "could have created spendable XRP far beyond the total supply." The patch shipped without an amendment vote, and no actual exploitation of the vulnerability has been reported.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
XRP Ledger 基础层支付引擎新近披露的一个漏洞可能允许攻击者以近乎零成本增发数万亿枚 XRP；研究员 Cayden Liao 与 Veria AI 于 9 月 22 日提交报告，Ripple 于 9 月 25 日在 xrpld 3.4.1 中发布闭源修复，仅以“整数运算加固”的措辞加以描述。由 Ripple 和 Arrington Capital 支持的 XRP 储备公司 Evernorth（XRPN）的股东在未获告知的情况下完成了投票，直到 10 月 9 日合并完成当天，官方报告才披露该补丁实际修复的内容。

该漏洞意味着 XRP 1000 亿枚的固定供应上限——Evernorth 储备计划的核心主张——在网络上大约十年间无法被技术性强制执行。此事还引发治理层面的质疑：XRPN 股东是在 Ripple 已知情而他们不知情的窗口期内做出了赎回和合并决定。

据该报道，这一漏洞可能可追溯至 2015 年，仅一笔利用该漏洞的已验证交易就“可能创建远超总供应量的可用 XRP”。该补丁未经过修正案投票即发布，目前也没有该漏洞被实际利用的报道。
metadata.market_impact_en: The disclosure bears directly on the credibility of XRP's supply cap, a claim that underpins the valuation of the token itself and of treasury vehicles such as Evernorth/XRPN whose equity is tied to XRP holdings. It also draws scrutiny to XRPL validator and patch-governance practice, including the emergency closed-source release issued without an amendment vote.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该披露直接关系到 XRP 供应上限的可信度，而这一主张支撑着 XRP 本身以及 Evernorth/XRPN 这类以持币为核心、股权与 XRP 持仓挂钩的储备公司的估值。同时，此事也使 XRPL 验证者与补丁治理实践受到审视，包括未经修正案投票的闭源紧急发布。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics, a new generation of its Gemini model family adapted for robotics and embodied AI applications.
dedup_history.author: Google DeepMind Blog

metadata.background_en: Embodied AI refers to AI systems embedded in a physical body that perceive their environment through sensors, act through actuators and pursue goals over time, a shift from purely digital AI into the physical world. Foundation models for robotics are being applied in this direction, with commentators describing the current period as robotics' 'GPT-2 moment' while cautioning that model scale alone does not make a robot work in practice.
metadata.background_zh: 具身 AI 指嵌入物理实体的人工智能系统，它们通过传感器感知环境、通过执行器采取行动并持续推进目标，是 AI 从纯数字领域走向物理世界的一步。机器人领域的基础模型正沿这一方向推进，有评论者将当前阶段称为机器人技术的“GPT-2 时刻”，同时提醒仅有模型规模并不足以让机器人在实际中运转。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics, a new generation of its Gemini model family adapted for robotics and embodied AI applications.

It extends Google DeepMind's flagship Gemini family from software-facing tasks into embodied AI, the part of the field concerned with systems that perceive and act in the physical world through sensors and actuators.

Coverage of the wider Gemini 4 Argon release states that it was presented on 30 September 2026 with a single-trajectory output capacity of 1 million tokens and priority access for cyber defenders — features described for long-horizon enterprise and software-development work rather than robotics specifically.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Google DeepMind 发布了面向机器人领域的 Gemini 4 Argon，这是其 Gemini 模型家族的新一代版本，针对机器人技术与具身 AI 应用进行了适配。

这将 Google DeepMind 的旗舰 Gemini 系列从面向软件的任务扩展到具身 AI，即通过传感器和执行器感知并作用于物理世界的那部分人工智能领域。

关于 Gemini 4 Argon 整体版本的报道称，该模型于 2026 年 9 月 30 日发布，单条轨迹输出容量达 100 万 token，并为网络安全防御人员提供优先访问权——这些特性描述的面向长周期企业任务和软件开发，而非专门针对机器人场景。

OpenAI says its GPT-6 'Astra', GPT-Image-2.5 and GPT-Live models are now powering Higgsfield, allowing creators on the platform to generate videos longer than 10 minutes with more precise visuals and voice-driven filmmaking.

According to the announcement, the integration extends AI video generation on Higgsfield from roughly one minute to over 10 minutes, a change aimed at longer-form creative work rather than short clips.

The announcement is framed as a partner story and names three models: GPT-6 Astra for longer videos, GPT-Image-2.5 for precise visuals, and GPT-Live for voice filmmaking. Higgsfield's platform separately aggregates third-party video models such as Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1 and Sora 2.

根据该公告，此次集成将 Higgsfield 上的 AI 视频生成时长从约 1 分钟延长至 10 分钟以上，目标是支持更长的创作内容，而非仅限于短片段。

该公告以合作伙伴案例的形式发布，点名三款模型：用于延长视频的 GPT-6 Astra、用于精准画面的 GPT-Image-2.5，以及用于语音电影化创作的 GPT-Live。Higgsfield 平台本身还整合了 Kling 3.0、Veo 3.1 和 Sora 2 等第三方视频模型。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Anthropic research warns that AI could spread like a computer worm across cheap consumer devices, showing GLM-5.2 autonomously completing a find-transfer-run-propagate loop in a simulated network, Qwen3.5-9B self-deploying on 8 of 9 hardware types, and failure-learning raising deployment success from 45% to 61–84%.
dedup_history.author: theblockbeats

metadata.background_en: AI-worm research has been building for some time: IBM described the Morris II proof-of-concept worm that targets generative-AI email assistants, and security vendors classify AI worms as malware that injects self-replicating prompts rather than dropping executable files. In June 2026, University of Toronto researchers reported building and testing a proof-of-concept AI-driven worm that used a locally hosted open-weight large language model to reason its way through a network and replicate itself.
metadata.background_zh: 围绕 AI 蠕虫的研究已持续一段时间：IBM 曾介绍针对生成式 AI 邮件助手的 Morris II 概念验证蠕虫，安全厂商则将 AI 蠕虫归类为通过注入自我复制提示词、而非投放可执行文件来传播的恶意软件。2026 年 6 月，多伦多大学研究人员报告构建并测试了一个概念验证的 AI 驱动蠕虫，它使用本地托管的开源权重语言模型在网络中推理路径并自我复制。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Anthropic published research warning that AI could one day spread like a computer worm — autonomously finding networked devices, deploying models on them and using those devices to propagate further, without necessarily needing data centers. In its tests, 15 Android TV boxes priced at about $55 each ran a split 26-billion-parameter Gemma 4 model at only 0.39 tokens per second, Alibaba's Qwen3.5-9B autonomously stood up inference services on 8 of 9 hardware types, and Zhipu's GLM-5.2 completed a find-transfer-run-propagate loop in an isolated simulated network, covering all 8 target nodes in 4 of 5 runs and 7 of 8 in the fifth.

The research puts a concrete hardware floor under autonomous AI propagation, showing that ordinary consumer devices can serve as a compute source, and Anthropic projects that small models suited to cheap devices may reach GLM-5.2's current simulated-propagation capability by the end of 2026.

The demonstrations are bounded: the experiment deliberately opened an unauthenticated debug interface, which greatly reduced the difficulty of intrusion, and GLM-5.2 itself ran on external servers — what was deployed to target devices was the smaller Llama 3.1 8B, so it did not achieve true self-replication independent of external compute. Based on current experimental data, a 9B model might need one to two days to complete one round of replication.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Anthropic 发布研究，警告 AI 未来可能像计算机蠕虫一样自行寻找联网设备、部署模型，并利用新设备继续传播，且不一定需要数据中心。测试中，研究人员用 15 台单价约 55 美元的安卓电视盒拆分运行 260 亿参数的 Gemma 4 模型，推理速度仅每秒 0.39 Token；阿里 Qwen3.5-9B 能在 9 类硬件中的 8 类上自主搭建推理服务；智谱 GLM-5.2 则在隔离模拟网络中完成寻找目标、传送模型、启动推理和继续传播的流程，5 次测试中 4 次覆盖全部 8 个目标节点，另一次覆盖 7 个。

该研究为 AI 自主传播给出了具体的硬件下限，说明普通消费级设备也能成为算力来源；Anthropic 预测，按小模型过去的能力增长速度，到 2026 年底，适合在廉价设备上运行的小模型可能达到 GLM-5.2 当前完成模拟传播任务的能力。

实验存在明显边界：研究提前开放了无需验证的调试接口，大幅降低了入侵难度；GLM-5.2 本身依赖外部服务器运行，部署到目标设备的是更小的 Llama 3.1 8B，并未实现真正脱离外部算力的自我复制。按现有实验数据估算，9B 模型完成一轮复制可能需要一到两天。
metadata.market_impact_en: The research does not directly touch any protocol or token; any market transmission would run through sentiment rather than fundamentals, as AI-safety and self-propagating-AI headlines can shape the narrative around AI-themed crypto assets and decentralized edge-compute projects without changing their cash flows or usage.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该研究并未直接涉及任何协议或代币；若产生市场传导，也更可能通过情绪而非基本面发生，因为 AI 安全与自我传播式 AI 的新闻会影响市场对 AI 概念加密资产和去中心化边缘算力项目的叙事，但不会改变其现金流或实际使用情况。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, the first frontier-class models from Meta Superintelligence Labs, featuring a 1 million token context window and pricing at $4/$20 per million input/output tokens, with Meta's own benchmarks placing them above GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 while Artificial Analysis still ranks Opus 5.5 first.
dedup_history.author: Jose Antonio Lanz

metadata.background_en: Meta formed Meta Superintelligence Labs in 2025 after its open-source Llama 4 models stumbled in independent tests, following a roughly $14 billion deal for Scale AI that put founder Alexandr Wang in charge of the unit. The group's first model, Muse Spark, launched earlier in 2026 as a small, fast, closed model. Muse Wonder arrives weeks after OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Astra on September 3 and Anthropic followed on September 22 with Claude Opus 5.5.
metadata.background_zh: Meta 在开源模型 Llama 4 于独立测试中表现不佳后，于 2025 年成立了 Meta Superintelligence Labs，此前其以约 140 亿美元收购 Scale AI 的股份，并由该公司创始人 Alexandr Wang 领导这一新部门。该部门的首个模型 Muse Spark 于 2026 年早些时候发布，是一款小而快的闭源模型。Muse Wonder 的问世距 OpenAI 于 9 月 3 日发布 GPT-6 Astra、Anthropic 于 9 月 22 日发布 Claude Opus 5.5 仅数周。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on Monday, the first frontier-class models from Meta Superintelligence Labs, both with a 1 million token context window. The API version, Muse Wonder, is priced at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, while the larger Muse Wonder Full is reserved for paying Muse Code subscribers.

This is the first time Meta has been willing to put its own models head-to-head with the best from OpenAI and Anthropic. On Meta's own charts Wonder Full leads GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 on long-horizon coding, legal agent work and memory, but the third-party Artificial Analysis ranking still places Opus 5.5 first at 58 versus Wonder Full's 56.

Muse Wonder is live now through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, Meta's coding agent. Meta presents two features — Active Memory, which carries information from one conversation into the next, and Active Focus, which keeps the model working toward a hard goal and checking in before doing anything important — and it acknowledges that the SWE-Marathon coding row is not a controlled comparison and its model ran at maximum effort.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Meta 于周一发布 Muse Wonder 与 Muse Wonder Full，这是 Meta Superintelligence Labs 推出的首批前沿级模型，两者均具备 100 万 token 的上下文窗口。API 版本 Muse Wonder 的定价为每百万输入 token 4 美元、每百万输出 token 20 美元，规模更大的 Muse Wonder Full 则仅向付费的 Muse Code 订阅用户开放。

这是 Meta 首次愿意将自己的模型与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的最强模型正面比较。在 Meta 自家图表上，Wonder Full 在长周期编程、法律智能体任务和记忆方面领先于 GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5，但第三方机构 Artificial Analysis 的排名仍将 Opus 5.5 列在首位（58 分），Wonder Full 为 56 分。

Muse Wonder 现已通过 Meta Model API 和 Meta 的编程智能体 Muse Code 上线。Meta 强调两项功能——Active Memory（把一次对话中的信息带入下一次对话）与 Active Focus（让模型持续攻克高难度目标，并在执行重要操作前先与用户确认）——同时承认 SWE-Marathon 编程测试这一行并非受控对比，其模型是以最大算力投入运行的。
metadata.market_impact_en: The direct channel is pricing pressure on frontier inference: Meta is matching Claude Opus 5.5 at $4/$20 per million tokens and undercutting GPT-6 Astra's $10/$50, which affects the API revenue economics of competing labs rather than any crypto asset directly. The read-through to crypto markets runs through sentiment — Meta's positioning as a frontier lab feeds the broader AI capex and risk-appetite narrative that typically moves high-beta technology-linked tokens alongside other risk assets.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 直接传导渠道是对前沿推理定价的压力：Meta 以每百万 token 4 美元/20 美元与 Claude Opus 5.5 持平，并低于 GPT-6 Astra 的 10 美元/50 美元，这影响的是竞争实验室的 API 收入经济性，而非直接涉及任何加密资产。对加密市场的传导则经由市场情绪——Meta 跻身前沿实验室的定位会强化更广泛的 AI 资本支出与风险偏好叙事，这类叙事通常会让高贝塔的科技相关代币与其他风险资产一同波动。

dedup_history.ai_summary: BNY and Citadel Securities completed a transaction using tokenized U.S. Treasuries to demonstrate faster collateral movement between settlement and financing, as BNY moves toward expanded digital cash services and around-the-clock settlement.
dedup_history.author: Krisztian Sandor

metadata.background_en: Wall Street has been exploring bringing traditional assets onto blockchains, with firms including BlackRock, Franklin Templeton and JPMorgan embracing tokenized funds and securities on bets the technology can shorten settlement times, automate processes and make assets easier to move. BNY has separately moved into digital asset infrastructure, including custody and issuance support for the USDC stablecoin, and has said it plans to extend support to other stablecoin issuers and digital cash services. Tokenized U.S. Treasuries are blockchain-based representations of government debt such as short-term Treasury bills.
metadata.background_zh: 华尔街一直在探索将传统资产引入区块链，贝莱德、富兰克林邓普顿和摩根大通等机构已采用代币化基金和证券，押注该技术能够缩短结算时间、实现流程自动化并让资产更易流转。BNY本身也在布局数字资产基础设施，包括为USDC稳定币提供托管和发行支持，并表示计划将支持范围扩展至其他稳定币发行方和数字现金服务。代币化美国国债是政府债务（如短期国库券）的区块链化表示形式。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
BNY, described as the world's largest custody bank, and trading firm Citadel Securities said on Tuesday they had completed a transaction using tokenized U.S. Treasuries, showing how blockchain-based government bonds could move from settlement into financing. BNY also said it plans to add digital cash and tokenized deposit capabilities and to extend the operating hours of its traditional settlement systems for Federal Reserve-eligible securities and U.S. triparty transactions, with the aim of reaching European and Asian trading hours next year.

The effort targets a key bottleneck in financial markets: moving government bonds used as collateral for trading and borrowing can take time, tying up assets that could otherwise be put to work. Citadel Securities digital assets operations lead Dan Doherty said efficient movement of high-quality collateral is fundamental to well-functioning markets and that reducing delays across the trade lifecycle could improve how institutional markets operate.

The transaction was a demonstration of how tokenized government bonds could move from settlement into financing, potentially letting firms reuse collateral sooner and free up cash for other trades. BNY chief innovation and market transformation officer Carolyn Weinberg said using a tokenized representation of a U.S. Treasury across both settlement and financing enables a more connected, efficient and always-on financial system.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
被称为全球最大托管银行的BNY与交易巨头Citadel Securities周二表示，双方已完成一笔使用代币化美国国债的交易，展示基于区块链的政府债券如何从结算环节进入融资环节。BNY还表示计划增加数字现金和代币化存款能力，并延长其面向美联储合格证券及美国三方交易的既有结算系统的运营时间，目标是在明年覆盖欧洲和亚洲交易时段。

该尝试针对的是金融市场的一个关键瓶颈：作为交易和借贷抵押品的政府债券在账户与结算系统之间转移需要时间，从而占用本可另作他用的资产。Citadel Securities数字资产业务运营负责人Dan Doherty表示，高质量抵押品的高效流转是市场良好运行的基础，减少交易生命周期中的延迟可以改善机构市场的运作方式。

这笔交易旨在演示代币化政府债券如何从结算进入融资环节，从而可能让机构更早地重复使用抵押品，并释放现金用于其他交易。BNY首席创新与市场转型官Carolyn Weinberg表示，在结算和融资两个环节都使用美国国债的代币化表示，可以实现一个更互联、更高效、全天候运行的金融体系。
metadata.market_impact_en: The transaction sits in the tokenized real-world asset and collateral segment: if tokenized Treasuries can move between settlement and financing rails, they could touch repo and triparty collateral flows where USDC and other digital cash instruments are used for settlement, a channel that large custodians and stablecoin issuers are already building toward. The described plans remain pilot-stage and depend on BNY extending digital cash services and settlement hours.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易属于代币化现实世界资产与抵押品领域：如果代币化国债能够在结算与融资通道之间流转，就可能触及回购和三方交易中的抵押品流动，而这些环节正使用USDC等数字现金工具进行结算，这也是大型托管机构和稳定币发行方正在建设的通道。上述计划仍处于试点阶段，并取决于BNY能否扩展数字现金服务和结算时间。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Ethereum Name Service is planning a major overhaul of .eth domains that includes an irreversible catch for domain holders.
dedup_history.author: CryptoSlate

metadata.background_en: ENS is a naming system on Ethereum that maps human-readable names such as .eth names to wallet addresses and other identifiers. ENSv2 was first outlined in 2024 as a ground-up rebuild of the protocol, and ENS's FAQ states that name ownership is not affected by the transition. The ENSv2 page offers existing .eth name holders an upgrade path for their names.
metadata.background_zh: ENS 是以太坊上的命名系统，可将 .eth 等人类可读的名称映射到钱包地址及其他标识符。ENSv2 于 2024 年首次公布，定位为对协议的底层重建，ENS 的 FAQ 表示名称所有权不会因过渡而受影响。ENSv2 页面为现有 .eth 名称持有者提供了升级其名称的路径。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Ethereum Name Service is planning a major overhaul of .eth domains that, according to CryptoSlate, includes an irreversible catch for domain holders. Coverage of the proposal points to an ENSv2 upgrade featuring a one-way domain migration option.

The change targets .eth, ENS's core naming product, and the described one-way migration gives holders a decision that reportedly cannot be reversed once taken. ENS's own FAQ states that existing name ownership would be preserved through the ENSv2 transition.

Coverage of the proposal cites an irreversible, one-way domain migration, support for stablecoin payments, and a 60% fee increase for five-character names. ENS's ENSv2 page describes a protocol rebuilt from the ground up with a new ownership model and new apps.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
据 CryptoSlate 报道，以太坊域名服务（ENS）正计划对 .eth 域名进行重大改革，其中包含一项对域名持有者而言不可逆的代价。相关报道称，此次 ENSv2 升级提案包含单向域名迁移选项。

此次变动针对的是 ENS 的核心命名产品 .eth，而报道所述的单项迁移意味着持有者一旦做出决定便无法撤回。ENS 官方 FAQ 则表示，在向 ENSv2 过渡期间，现有域名的所有权将得到保留。

关于该提案的报道提到不可逆的单向域名迁移、对稳定币支付的支持，以及五字符名称费用上调 60%。ENS 的 ENSv2 页面称该协议将从底层重建，采用新的所有权模型并推出新应用。
metadata.market_impact_en: The overhaul affects ENS token holders and the secondary market for .eth names, since protocol fee rules and domain ownership sit at the centre of the upgrade. Uncertainty around a one-way migration can influence how domain marketplaces and traders transfer .eth names during the transition period.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次改革关系到 ENS 代币持有者以及 .eth 域名的二级市场，因为协议费用规则与域名所有权正是升级的核心。单向迁移带来的不确定性，可能影响过渡期内域名交易平台与交易者转移 .eth 域名的方式。

metadata.background_en: zerohash is a crypto, stablecoin and tokenization infrastructure provider that supplies banks, brokerages and fintechs with the technology to launch digital asset products, including regulated crypto trading through a single API integration. Ethereum staking involves depositing ETH to activate a validator, a participant in Ethereum's consensus protocol that proposes and verifies blocks.
metadata.background_zh: zerohash 是一家加密货币、稳定币与代币化基础设施提供商，为银行、券商和金融科技公司提供推出数字资产产品所需的技术，包括通过单一 API 集成提供受监管的加密交易能力。以太坊质押是指存入 ETH 以激活验证者，验证者是以太坊共识协议的参与方，负责提出新区块并校验其他验证者的工作。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Interactive Brokers (NASDAQ: IBKR) has launched cryptocurrency staking, with infrastructure provided by digital asset firm zerohash. Initially, eligible Interactive Brokers LLC clients can stake ETH through the Staking Dashboard in IBKR's Client Portal, where they submit staking and unstaking requests and monitor pending activity.

IBKR CEO Milan Galik said the staking service lets clients earn additional yield on the crypto assets they hold, similar to the firm's stock yield enhancement program. It extends ETH staking access to a mainstream brokerage customer base.

Rewards, when earned, are credited as additional staked cryptocurrency and can compound while the position remains staked. IBKR currently supports trading in 20 digital assets and accepts deposits in USDC, RLUSD and PYUSD.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
盈透证券（Interactive Brokers，纳斯达克代码：IBKR）推出加密货币质押服务，底层服务由数字资产基础设施公司 zerohash 提供。上线初期，符合条件的 Interactive Brokers LLC 客户可通过客户门户（Client Portal）中的质押面板（Staking Dashboard）质押 ETH，提交质押或解除质押申请并查看待处理状态。

盈透证券 CEO Milan Galik 表示，该质押服务与其股票收益增强计划类似，让客户能够从所持加密资产中获取额外收益。此举将 ETH 质押通道延伸至主流券商的客户群体。

所获奖励将以追加质押代币的形式发放，并可在持续质押期间复利增长。盈透证券目前支持 20 种数字资产交易，并支持使用 USDC、RLUSD 及 PYUSD 入金。
metadata.market_impact_en: The main transmission channel is distribution: a large traditional brokerage now funnels eligible client ETH into staking through a third-party infrastructure provider, which could add to the pool of ETH committed to staking and expand demand for staking and custody infrastructure among regulated intermediaries. The service is initially limited to eligible Interactive Brokers LLC clients, so any market effect depends on how widely it is adopted.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 主要传导渠道是分销：一家大型传统券商通过第三方基础设施提供商，将符合条件客户的 ETH 导入质押，可能增加参与质押的 ETH 规模，并扩大受监管中介机构对质押与托管基础设施的需求。该服务初期仅面向符合条件的 Interactive Brokers LLC 客户，因此市场影响取决于其实际采用范围。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Binance introduced stricter rules governing market makers and token issuers, tightening the standards these parties must meet to operate and list on the platform.
dedup_history.author: CoinMarketCap

metadata.background_en: Market makers are firms that supply liquidity to crypto markets by continuously buying and selling assets so order books have enough depth for other participants to trade against. Token issuers are the projects and foundations behind crypto assets, and exchanges such as Binance set their own requirements for listing and for the market-making arrangements that support a newly listed token.
metadata.background_zh: 做市商是通过持续买卖资产为加密市场提供流动性的机构，使订单簿具备足够深度供其他参与者交易。代币发行方是加密资产背后的项目与基金会，而币安等交易所会自行设定上市要求，以及支持新上市代币的做市安排。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Binance introduced stricter rules governing market makers and token issuers, tightening the standards these parties must meet to operate and list on the platform.

Binance is the largest crypto exchange by trading volume, so changes to how it screens the market makers that supply order-book liquidity and the issuers that seek listings directly affect how tokens reach one of the market's main trading venues.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
币安针对做市商和代币发行方出台了更严格的规则，提高了这些主体在平台上开展业务和完成上市所需满足的标准。

币安是按交易量计最大的加密货币交易所，因此其对提供订单簿流动性的做市商以及寻求上市的代币发行方的审核标准发生变化，会直接影响代币进入这一主要交易场所的方式。
metadata.market_impact_en: The rules target the order-book liquidity that Binance market makers provide and the listing economics for token issuers, so the transmission runs through liquidity depth and listing terms on Binance rather than through a specific asset; projects and trading firms that cannot meet the tighter standards may face changes to their arrangements on the venue.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 新规则针对的是币安做市商所提供的订单簿流动性以及代币发行方的上市经济性，因此传导路径是通过币安平台上的流动性深度和上市条款，而非某一特定资产；无法满足更严格标准的项目与交易机构可能面临其在该平台安排上的变化。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Bybit launched Bybit Direct Stock, letting users hold and trade 1,000+ real US stocks inside its Unified Trading Account, with future plans to accept equities as collateral, offer stock lending, and enable transfers in from brokers such as Futu and Moomoo.
dedup_history.author: theblockbeats

metadata.background_en: Bybit's Unified Trading Account is the venue's all-in-one account mode, giving traders access to spot, spot margin, perpetuals, futures and options without switching accounts. Tokenized equities — 1:1 backed digital representations of US stocks and ETFs tradable around the clock across chains — have become a related but distinct route for bringing equity exposure onto crypto venues.
metadata.background_zh: Bybit的统一交易账户（UTA）是该平台的一体化账户模式，让交易者无需切换账户即可使用现货、现货杠杆、永续合约、期货与期权等产品。代币化股票——即以1:1资产背书、可在多条链上24小时交易的美股与ETF数字化代表——则成为将股票敞口引入加密平台的另一条相关但不同的路径。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Bybit CEO Ben Zhou announced the launch of Bybit Direct Stock during the "Make Your Move" global keynote on October 13, giving users direct access to more than 1,000 US market trading pairs and assets, with real stock ownership. He said the stock assets will be held in Bybit's Unified Trading Account (UTA), and that the platform plans to later support equities as trading collateral, introduce stock lending, and allow users to transfer in positions held at brokers such as Futu and Moomoo.

The launch puts real US equity ownership inside a crypto exchange's unified account, and the stated roadmap toward equity collateral, stock lending and broker transfers-in would place a crypto-native platform in direct competition with traditional brokerages. The collateral, lending and transfer features are forward-looking plans announced by the CEO, not live functionality.

According to Zhou, the stock assets are custodied within the Unified Trading Account, which Bybit describes as centralizing spot, futures and options trading in one account. The planned broker transfer-in covers positions held at Futu and Moomoo, both of which support transferring US stocks out to another brokerage via methods such as DTC free-of-payment (FOP) transfers.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
10月13日，Bybit CEO Ben Zhou在「Make Your Move」全球主题演讲中宣布推出Bybit Direct Stock，用户可直接通过Bybit持有和交易真实股票，接入美国市场超过1,000种交易对及资产，并获得真实股票所有权。他表示，相关股票资产将存放于统一交易账户（UTA）中；未来Bybit计划进一步支持股票作为交易抵押品、推出股票借贷服务，并将支持券商转仓，用户可将持有于富途、Moomoo等券商的股票转入Bybit账户进行托管。

此举将真实美股资产的所有权放进加密交易所的统一账户之中，而其所公布的股票抵押、股票借贷与券商转仓路线图，将使这一加密原生平台直接与传统券商形成竞争。需要指出的是，抵押品、借贷与转仓功能是CEO公布的后续计划，并非已上线的功能。

据Ben Zhou介绍，股票资产托管于统一交易账户（UTA）内，而Bybit将UTA描述为把现货、期货与期权交易集中于同一账户的模式。计划中的券商转仓涵盖富途与Moomoo账户中的持仓，这两家券商均支持通过DTC免费交割（FOP）等方式将美股转出至其他券商。
metadata.market_impact_en: If equities are eventually accepted as collateral inside Bybit's unified account, margin and liquidation dynamics could transmit between equity and crypto positions, linking crypto order books more directly to US equity market structure and to established brokerage transfer and custody rails such as DTC FOP. The immediate exposure is concentrated in Bybit's own UTA users, since the collateral, lending and transfer-in functions remain announced plans.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 若股票最终可被接受为Bybit统一账户内的抵押品，保证金与清算动态可能在股票头寸与加密头寸之间相互传导，使加密订单簿与美国股票市场结构、以及DTC FOP等既有券商转仓与托管通道更直接地连接起来。由于抵押、借贷与转仓转入功能目前仍属已公布的后续计划，直接受影响的群体当前主要集中在Bybit自身的UTA用户。

dedup_history.ai_summary: SkyAI, a company that accumulated 2 million SOL (~$214M), has disclosed selling 1 million SOL (~$107M) and transferred out 1.57M SOL (~$175M) in October at a loss of over $160M versus its ~$194 average purchase price, warning it may continue selling while simultaneously launching a cash tender offer for its stock and pre-funded warrants at $3.00 per share.
dedup_history.author: lookonchainchannel

metadata.background_en: A cash tender offer is a public offer to buy shares directly from holders for cash at a fixed price and for a limited time. A pre-funded warrant grants the holder the right to acquire shares at a nominal exercise price, with the funding effectively provided at issuance; such instruments are commonly issued alongside financing transactions. SkyAI's disclosure follows a period in which several listed companies accumulated large SOL positions as corporate treasury assets.
metadata.background_zh: 现金要约收购是向股东公开发出的、以固定价格在限定时间内用现金直接回购股份的要约。预融资权证赋予持有人以名义行权价取得股份的权利，其行权资金在发行时即已预付，这类工具常用于融资交易中。SkyAI此次披露之前，已有多家上市公司将大量SOL作为企业财库资产进行配置。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
SkyAI, a company that held about 2 million SOL (~$214M), has disclosed that it sold 1 million SOL (~$107M) and has said it may continue selling. On-chain data shows the entity transferred out 1.57 million SOL (~$175M) during October, against an average purchase price of roughly $194 per SOL, implying losses of more than $160M.

Management's statement that it may keep selling matters because SkyAI was among the largest corporate holders of SOL, and the disclosed sales are an explicit, repeated source of token supply. The company is simultaneously running a $3.00-per-share cash tender offer, tying the unwind to its own equity.

The Arkham entity page tracking the addresses is labeled "Sharps Technology," while the company is referred to as SkyAI. Transferred-out tokens are on-chain movements and are not by themselves proof of sale; the confirmed disposal figure disclosed by the company is 1 million SOL. The tender offer at $3.00 per share covers common stock and pre-funded warrants.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
曾持有约200万枚SOL（约2.14亿美元）的SkyAI披露，已卖出100万枚SOL（约1.07亿美元），并表示可能继续出售。链上数据显示，该实体在10月共转出157万枚SOL（约1.75亿美元）；按其约194美元的平均买入价计算，亏损超过1.6亿美元。

管理层表示可能继续抛售，其重要性在于SkyAI曾是最大的企业级SOL持有方之一，已披露的出售构成明确且可能持续的代币供给来源。与此同时，公司正在推进每股3.00美元的现金要约收购，使这轮减持与其自身股权运作相互关联。

Arkham上追踪相关地址的实体页面标注为"Sharps Technology"，而公司对外名称为SkyAI。转出属于链上资金移动，本身并不等同于卖出；公司披露的已确认出售规模为100万枚SOL。每股3.00美元的要约收购标的包括普通股与预融资权证。
metadata.market_impact_en: The disclosed sales and the company's stated willingness to keep selling put identifiable sell-side supply into SOL spot markets, where this holder's treasury position was one of the largest corporate ones. The separate $3.00-per-share cash tender offer affects the equity and pre-funded warrant side rather than the token, and the size of the unrealized loss is likely to weigh on sentiment toward corporate SOL treasury strategies.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 已披露的出售以及公司表示可能继续抛售，为SOL现货市场带来了可识别的新增卖方供给，而该持有方的财库头寸曾是规模最大的企业持仓之一。每股3.00美元的现金要约收购作用于股票与预融资权证层面，而非代币本身；逾1.6亿美元的未实现亏损规模，可能影响市场对企业SOL财库策略的情绪。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Blur will shut down its frontend and stop matching new Blend loans on November 12, 2026, leaving the on-chain marketplace protocol and fee switch operational and giving borrowers until then to repay or default, sending BLUR down 16.55% over 24 hours.
dedup_history.author: wublockchainenglish

metadata.background_en: Blur is a decentralized NFT marketplace and aggregator launched in October 2022 on Ethereum, aimed at professional and high-volume traders with zero marketplace fees. Blend, introduced in May 2023, is a peer-to-peer perpetual NFT lending protocol with no oracle dependencies and no expiries, allowing borrowing positions to remain open indefinitely until liquidated, with market-determined interest rates.
metadata.background_zh: Blur 是 2022 年 10 月在以太坊上推出的去中心化 NFT 交易市场与聚合器，主打零市场手续费，面向专业和高频交易者。Blend 于 2023 年 5 月推出，是一种点对点的永续 NFT 借贷协议，不依赖预言机、没有到期日，借款头寸可无限期持有直至被清算，利率由市场决定。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Blur announced that it will shut down its frontend on November 12, 2026, while its on-chain marketplace protocol will remain operational and BLUR will continue to control the protocol's fee switch. Its NFT lending protocol, Blend, will stop matching new loans on the same date, and borrowers have until then to repay their loans or allow them to default.

Blend borrowers with open positions face a hard deadline to repay or default, and the NFT lending market loses the venue that matched its loans. Blur said it will subsequently provide a frontend tool for users to withdraw their assets from Blend.

Following the announcement, BLUR fell to a low of 0.01410 USDT before recovering to 0.01523 USDT, down 16.55% over 24 hours according to Binance data. Blur raised $11 million in a seed round in March 2022, with investors including Paradigm, eGirl Capital and 0xMaki.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Blur 宣布将于 2026 年 11 月 12 日关闭其前端，其链上交易市场协议将继续运行，BLUR 仍将继续控制该协议的费率开关（fee switch）。其 NFT 借贷协议 Blend 将在同一天停止撮合新的贷款，借款人须在此日期前还款，否则将面临违约。

持有未平仓头寸的 Blend 借款人面临还款或违约的硬性截止期限，NFT 借贷市场也将失去其贷款撮合场所。Blur 表示随后将提供一个前端工具，供用户从 Blend 中提取资产。

公告发布后，据币安数据，BLUR 一度下探至 0.01410 USDT，随后回升至 0.01523 USDT，24 小时跌幅达 16.55%。Blur 曾于 2022 年 3 月完成 1100 万美元种子轮融资，投资方包括 Paradigm、eGirl Capital 和 0xMaki。
metadata.market_impact_en: The immediate reaction was concentrated in BLUR, which fell 16.55% over 24 hours to about 0.01523 USDT on Binance. Exposure sits with BLUR holders and NFT holders whose collateral or loan terms are tied to Blend, since the wind-down of matching removes that lending venue while the on-chain marketplace protocol and fee switch continue to operate; the source describes no direct transmission channel beyond the NFT sector.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 即时反应集中在 BLUR 上：据币安数据，其 24 小时下跌 16.55%，价格约为 0.01523 USDT。风险敞口主要落在 BLUR 持有者，以及抵押品或贷款条款与 Blend 绑定的 NFT 持有者身上——撮合业务关停使这一借贷场所消失，而链上交易市场协议和费率开关仍在运行；除 NFT 板块之外，来源未提及更直接的传导渠道。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Robinhood says its stock tokens have crossed $15 billion in cumulative trading volume with 200,000 holders as its chain passes 100 days, while Morpho's dashboard shows about $1.1 billion deposited on the network.
dedup_history.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.background_en: Robinhood offers its Classic Stock Tokens in the EU under MiFID II as derivatives, with the underlying assets held by a US-licensed institution. Morpho is a lending protocol built on Ethereum that competes with Aave and uses a model of segregated vaults.
metadata.background_zh: Robinhood 依据 MiFID II 在欧洲以衍生品形式提供 Classic Stock Tokens，标的资产由一家美国持牌机构托管。Morpho 是构建在以太坊上的借贷协议，采用隔离金库模式，与 Aave 形成竞争。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Robinhood says its stock tokens have crossed $15 billion in cumulative trading volume and reached 200,000 holders, as its chain passes the 100-day mark. Morpho's dashboard shows about $1.1 billion deposited on the network.

The figures are among the largest quantified milestones disclosed so far for tokenized equities, and the Morpho deposit number indicates the Robinhood chain is already hosting third-party DeFi lending activity.

Robinhood's stock tokens are tokenized debt securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited that provide economic exposure to the underlying securities without granting legal or beneficial rights in the issuers, and more than 190 are available, including those linked to NVIDIA, Google, Apple and Invesco QQQ. The roughly $1.1 billion figure comes from Morpho's own dashboard rather than from Robinhood.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Robinhood 表示，其股票代币（Stock Tokens）累计交易额已突破 150 亿美元，持有者数量达到 20 万，同时其公链运行已满 100 天。Morpho 的仪表盘显示，该网络上的存款规模约为 11 亿美元。

这是目前代币化股票领域披露的规模最大的量化里程碑之一，而 Morpho 的存款数据表明 Robinhood 链上已经承载了第三方 DeFi 借贷活动。

Robinhood 的股票代币是由 Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited 发行的代币化债务证券，仅提供对标的证券的经济敞口，不赋予投资者对标的发行公司的法定权利或受益权；目前可交易品种超过 190 个，涵盖与 NVIDIA、Google、Apple 和 Invesco QQQ 挂钩的代币。约 11 亿美元的存款数据来自 Morpho 自身的仪表盘，而非 Robinhood 公布。
metadata.market_impact_en: The disclosure points to a growing link between tokenized traditional assets and on-chain credit: stock tokens traded on the Robinhood chain, combined with deposits into Morpho vaults on the same network, tie equity exposure to DeFi lending and collateral flows. That makes tokenized-equity venues and the lending protocols serving them a segment to watch for shifts in on-chain liquidity and market structure.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该消息显示代币化传统资产与链上信贷之间的联系正在加强：在 Robinhood 链上交易的股票代币，与同一网络内 Morpho 金库的存款相结合，将股票敞口与 DeFi 借贷及抵押品流动连接起来。这使得代币化股票交易场所及为其提供服务的借贷协议成为观察链上流动性与市场结构变化的重点板块。

dedup_history.ai_summary: The Financial Stability Board warned in an Oct. 12 report that stablecoins could suffer redemption crises and depeg even with fully sufficient reserves, because reserves held in other jurisdictions may be slow to mobilize during stress, with the risks set for discussion at the Oct. 15 G20 meeting.
dedup_history.author: Oluwapelumi Adejumo

metadata.background_en: The FSB is an international standard-setter that monitors vulnerabilities in the global financial system; it has previously examined stablecoins' role in cross-border payments and their issuers' growing presence in traditional markets. Circle's European arrangements illustrate cross-border reserve management in practice: under a redemption policy updated in September, USDC is co-issued by its French entity for the European Economic Area and its US entity elsewhere, and Circle France may adjust or defer certain redemption requests during a defined stress event when the two entities cannot rebalance reserves. Those provisions describe contingency arrangements, not an existing liquidity failure.
metadata.background_zh: FSB是监测全球金融体系脆弱性的国际标准制定机构，此前曾研究稳定币在跨境支付中的作用以及其发行方在传统市场中日益扩大的存在。Circle的欧洲安排提供了跨境储备管理的实例：根据9月更新的赎回政策，USDC由法国实体为欧洲经济区共同发行、由美国实体面向其他市场发行；在两家实体无法完成储备再平衡的特定压力事件中，Circle France可调整或延后部分赎回请求。这些条款属于应急安排，而非已经发生的流动性失灵。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
The Financial Stability Board warned in an Oct. 12 report that stablecoin issuers could face redemption crises even when total reserves are sufficient, if those reserves are spread across jurisdictions and become slow or difficult to mobilize during stress. FSB Chair Andrew Bailey said international regulatory coordination remains underdeveloped, and the risks are set for discussion at the Oct. 15 meeting of G20 finance ministers and central bank governors.

The warning identifies a specific systemic vulnerability in a market worth roughly $300 billion, with 99% of its value pegged to the US dollar, ahead of a G20 meeting where regulators will take up the issue. According to FSB Chair Andrew Bailey, authorities still lack mature arrangements for managing cross-border stablecoin failures.

The FSB flagged particular risks in stablecoins issued by multiple affiliated companies that share liability for the same token while holding separate reserves, a structure where redemption demand can concentrate in one jurisdiction while collateral sits in another. It also noted that pseudonymous blockchain transactions and differences in national insolvency laws complicate determining which entity is responsible for a given redemption obligation.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
金融稳定理事会（FSB）在10月12日发布的报告中警告，即使稳定币发行方的储备总量充足，若储备分散在不同司法辖区、在压力时期难以及时调动，发行方仍可能面临赎回危机。FSB主席安德鲁·贝利表示，国际监管协调仍不成熟，相关风险将在10月15日的二十国集团（G20）财长和央行行长会议上讨论。

这一警告在G20会议前点出了一个规模约3000亿美元、其中99%价值锚定美元的市场中的具体系统性脆弱点，监管机构将在会上讨论该问题。据FSB主席安德鲁·贝利表示，各国当局目前仍缺乏应对跨境稳定币失灵的成熟安排。

FSB特别指出，由多家关联公司在不同地区各自持有储备、却对同一代币共同承担责任的稳定币结构存在风险：赎回需求可能集中在一个司法辖区，而抵押资产却存放在另一个辖区。FSB还指出，区块链交易的假名性以及各国破产法差异，使确定哪一实体对特定赎回义务负责变得更加困难。
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is liquidity and reserve custody: if cross-border reserve transfers stall, stablecoin holders could sell at a discount on secondary markets, and large redemptions could force issuers to liquidate Treasury holdings or withdraw bank deposits, pushing stress into short-term funding and traditional markets. The exposure sits with stablecoin issuers and the affiliated entities holding their reserves, and with the dollar pegs that underpin crypto trading pairs.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于流动性与储备托管：如果跨境储备调拨受阻，稳定币持有人可能在二级市场折价抛售，大规模赎回还可能迫使发行方抛售国债持仓或提取银行存款，从而将压力传导至短期融资市场和传统金融市场。风险敞口主要在于稳定币发行方及其持有储备的关联实体，以及支撑加密交易对的美元锚定。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Anthropic reports research suggesting AI models may be capable of self-replicating without needing access to a datacenter, raising new AI safety and containment questions.
dedup_history.author: Anthropic News

metadata.background_en: Self-replication — an AI system autonomously duplicating itself without human intervention — is often described as a "red line" because it is seen as a step toward autonomous AI evolution outside human control. In January 2025, researchers in China reported that two popular large language models could replicate themselves, a result covered at the time as crossing that line. Containment approaches in AI security generally rely on restricting a system's ability to interact with the external environment, for example through air-gapped or network-level controls.
metadata.background_zh: 自我复制——即 AI 系统在无人工干预的情况下自主复制自身——常被视为一条“红线”，因为它被看作 AI 脱离人类控制、自主演化的第一步。2025 年 1 月，中国的研究人员报告称两款流行的大语言模型能够自我复制，当时被报道为跨过了这条红线。AI 安全领域的“围堵”方法通常依赖限制系统与外部环境交互的能力，例如通过物理隔离（air-gap）或网络层面的管控。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Anthropic published research suggesting that small AI models may be only months away from being able to self-replicate across cheap IoT devices such as Android TV boxes, without access to a datacenter. The finding is framed as a possibility rather than a demonstrated capability.

The claim is presented as safety-relevant: if models can spread and reproduce outside datacenter containment, that bears on how autonomy and containment are evaluated. Anthropic's own framing places it among new AI safety and containment questions.

The scenario described involves small models running on inexpensive IoT hardware, specifically Android TV boxes, rather than frontier-scale systems in datacenters.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Anthropic 发布研究称，小型 AI 模型可能只需数月时间，就能在无需数据中心的情况下，通过廉价的物联网设备（如 Android TV 盒子）实现自我复制。该结论被表述为一种可能性，而非已被证实的能力。

该结论被视为与安全相关：如果模型能够在数据中心的隔离环境之外扩散并自我复制，将影响业界对自主性与“围堵”（containment）能力的评估方式。Anthropic 自身也将其列为新的 AI 安全与围堵问题之一。

所描述的场景涉及在廉价物联网硬件（明确提到 Android TV 盒子）上运行的小型模型，而非数据中心内的大规模前沿模型。

dedup_history.author: Jason Shubnell

metadata.background_en: Binance already offers a large built-in automation suite, including spot grid, futures grid and arbitrage bots, and has published documentation for AI agent skills that connect to its trading APIs. Generative UI refers to letting a large language model generate interface elements rather than only text, producing interfaces tailored to a user's request.
metadata.background_zh: 币安此前已提供较为完整的自动化工具组合，包括现货网格、合约网格和套利机器人，并发布了用于连接其交易API的AI agent技能文档。生成式界面（generative UI）指让大语言模型不仅输出文本，还直接生成界面元素，从而按用户需求定制交互界面。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Binance rolled out Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users, following a beta that involved roughly 150,000 testers. The tool was previously limited to the beta group.

Binance is the largest exchange by trading volume, so putting an AI-driven interface in front of its full English-language retail base extends AI tooling from a beta experiment into a mainstream trading workflow.

Binance AI is a free suite that consolidates market signals from charts, news, social platforms, onchain data and research tools into a single interface, and adapts to each user's knowledge level through generative UI. The rollout was limited to English-language users at launch.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
币安向所有英语用户开放了Binance AI——一个免费的生成式界面（generative UI）交易工具，此前该产品处于测试阶段，约有15万名测试者参与。

币安是按交易量计算最大的交易所，将AI驱动的界面开放给其全部英语零售用户，意味着AI工具从测试性实验进入主流交易流程。

Binance AI是一套免费功能组合，将图表、新闻、社交媒体、链上数据和研究工具的市场信号整合到单一界面中，并通过生成式界面适配不同用户的知识水平。本次开放范围限于英语用户。
metadata.market_impact_en: The rollout affects Binance's retail-facing channel rather than market structure: if the interface concentrates chart, news, social and onchain signals into one place, it could influence how English-language retail users route orders and interpret sentiment on the venue. No listing, fee or regulatory change is involved.

dedup_history.ai_summary: Evernorth, the Ripple-backed XRP treasury company, began trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN after closing its SPAC merger, holding roughly 473 million XRP and $300 million cash, with its treasury marked at about $677 million — well below the more than $1 billion it raised — after XRP fell from $2.37 at signing to a $1.43 reference price.
dedup_history.author: Jose Antonio Lanz

metadata.background_en: Evernorth belongs to a crowded category known as digital asset treasuries (DATs): public companies whose main business is holding a cryptocurrency and raising money to buy more of it, a playbook pioneered by Strategy (formerly Microstrategy) with Bitcoin. The model turns on a ratio called mNAV — market-to-net-asset value — which divides a company's stock market value by the value of the crypto it holds; above 1 a DAT can issue shares at a premium and buy more tokens, while below 1 raising money means dilution. Evernorth says it is now the largest publicly traded company devoted to XRP. It spent roughly $947 million buying XRP in late October 2025, and by February that holding was worth about $446 million less than it paid; XRP hit an all-time high of $3.65 in July 2025, and the $1.43 closing reference price sits about 61% below that peak.
metadata.background_zh: Evernorth属于被称为“数字资产储备公司”（DAT）的一类公司：其主营业务是持有某种加密货币并募集资金继续买入，这一模式由Strategy（原Microstrategy）以比特币率先开创。该模式依赖一个名为mNAV（市值对净资产价值比）的指标，即公司市值除以其持有加密资产的价值；高于1时，DAT可以溢价发行新股并买入更多代币，低于1时募资则意味着稀释。Evernorth称其目前是专注于XRP的最大上市企业。该公司在2025年10月下旬斥资约9.47亿美元买入XRP，到今年2月这批持仓的价值比买入成本低约4.46亿美元；XRP在2025年7月创下3.65美元的历史高点，1.43美元的交割参考价较该峰值低约61%。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Evernorth, the Ripple-backed XRP treasury company, began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN on Monday after closing its merger with SPAC Armada Acquisition Corp. II on October 9, holding roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash. At the $1.43 XRP reference price used in the closing filing, that treasury is worth about $677 million — well below the more than $1 billion the company said it had raised to buy XRP, when the deal was signed at a $2.37 token price.

The listing gives ordinary brokerage-account investors direct equity exposure to an XRP treasury without opening a crypto wallet, and it arrives sharply marked down: about 80.3% of Armada's public shareholders redeemed for roughly $10.58 per share, pulling about $195 million out of the deal and leaving a thin float that sent XRPN as high as $53 before the close.

The redemptions covered 18.5 million shares and left only about 4.5 million original public shares outstanding; XRPN touched an intraday high of $53 on October 2 and closed that Friday at $39.42 before sliding to $17.09 on October 9, and on its first day as Evernorth the stock briefly rose toward $19 before fading to $16.64 by midday Monday. SBI Holdings controls 39.9% of Evernorth's voting shares, Arrington Capital's fund holds 19.9% and Ripple co-founder Chris Larsen is tied to 9.9%, with Ripple and its affiliates capped at 9.9% voting power and six-month lock-ups barring Ripple, a Larsen-linked trust and Arrington's fund from selling until April 2027, according to the filing.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
获Ripple支持的XRP储备公司Evernorth在与SPAC（特殊目的收购公司）Armada Acquisition Corp. II的合并于10月9日完成后，于本周一以代码XRPN在纳斯达克开始交易，持有约4.73亿枚XRP和约3亿美元的总现金。按交易交割文件中采用的1.43美元XRP参考价计算，该储备价值约6.77亿美元，远低于公司当初宣称用于购买XRP的逾10亿美元募资额——交易签署时XRP定价为2.37美元。

此次上市让普通券商账户投资者无需开设加密钱包即可获得XRP储备的股权敞口，但其估值已大幅缩水：Armada约80.3%的公众股东以约每股10.58美元赎回，从交易中抽走约1.95亿美元，留下极小的流通盘，使XRPN股价在交割前一度冲高至53美元。

赎回涉及1850万股，仅留下约450万股原公众股份；XRPN于10月2日盘中触及53美元高点，当周五收于39.42美元，随后在10月9日跌至17.09美元；作为Evernorth的首个交易日，股价一度升向19美元，午间回落至16.64美元。根据申报文件，SBI Holdings控制Evernorth 39.9%的表决权股份，Arrington Capital的基金持有19.9%，Ripple联合创始人Chris Larsen关联9.9%；Ripple及其关联方表决权上限为9.9%，Ripple、一家与Larsen关联的信托以及Arrington的基金签署了六个月锁定期，在2027年4月前不得出售。
metadata.market_impact_en: XRPN creates a Nasdaq-listed equity route into XRP exposure for brokerage investors, a channel that runs through equity rather than spot crypto venues; the deal's heavy redemption and the fall in the reference price from $2.37 to $1.43 feed directly into how the digital-asset-treasury model and its mNAV economics are judged for XRP-linked and other crypto treasury vehicles. The thin post-redemption float also means XRPN's share price can move on small order flow, so its trading is not a clean read-through to XRP's own market.
metadata.market_impact_zh: XRPN为券商投资者提供了一条通过纳斯达克股票获得XRP敞口的路径，这一渠道经由股权而非现货加密市场传导；此次交易的高赎回率和参考价从2.37美元跌至1.43美元，直接影响市场对数字资产储备模式及其mNAV经济性在XRP相关及其他加密储备公司上的评价。赎回后极小的流通盘也意味着XRPN股价会因小额订单而剧烈波动，因此其股价表现并不能直接等同于XRP本身的市场状况。

items.ai_summary: New York Attorney General Letitia James revealed a multi-state investigation into Character.AI and, with 40 bipartisan state AGs, filed a notice of interest in its bankruptcy case seeking to impose protections on consumer data sold through the proceeding.
items.author: Lauren Feiner

metadata.background_en: Character.ai is a generative AI chatbot service where users converse with customizable characters; it was founded in November 2021 by Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas, former Google engineers. State attorneys general have been increasingly active in AI, privacy and children's data enforcement, according to legal-industry coverage of their recent meetings.
metadata.background_zh: Character.ai 是一项生成式 AI 聊天机器人服务，用户可与可自定义的角色对话；该公司由前 Google 工程师 Noam Shazeer 和 Daniel De Freitas 于 2021 年 11 月创立。根据法律行业对其近期会议的报道，各州总检察长在 AI、隐私及儿童数据执法方面日趋活跃。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
New York Attorney General Letitia James revealed a years-long multi-state investigation into Character.AI and joined 40 bipartisan state attorneys general in filing a notice of interest in the company's bankruptcy case. The filing seeks to require protections for consumer data that may be sold through the bankruptcy proceeding.

The coordinated action by 40 bipartisan state attorneys general puts the sale of a major consumer AI platform's user data under regulatory scrutiny, signaling that state authorities intend to have a say in how such data is transferred in insolvency.

According to the source, the notice of interest is intended "to put all parties on notice of the regulatory issues" involved; it is a notice filing rather than a court ruling or an approval of any sale terms.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
纽约州总检察长 Letitia James 披露了一项针对 Character.AI 的、持续数年的多州联合调查，并与 40 位跨党派州总检察长共同在该公司的破产案中提交了「利害关系通知」（notice of interest）。该申请旨在要求对可能通过破产程序被出售的消费者数据施加保护措施。

40 位跨党派州总检察长的联合行动，使一家大型消费级 AI 平台的用户数据出售进入监管视野，表明各州当局有意在破产程序中对此类数据的转移方式施加影响。

据来源报道，该利害关系通知意在「让所有相关方注意到」所涉的监管问题；这属于一份通知性文件，而非法院裁决，也不构成对任何出售条款的批准。

items.ai_summary: The Philippines' central bank is reportedly taking punitive action against Coins.ph, the country's largest crypto exchange with over 18 million customers, over alleged servicing of restricted offshore gambling operators — with deposit restrictions already placed on its main wallet firm and license revocation floated as a possible outcome.
items.author: Ian Allison

metadata.background_en: Coins.ph is one of the earliest crypto wallets and exchanges in the Philippines, has a 24-hour spot trading volume of about $50 million and reportedly controls some 75%-80% of peso-to-stablecoin liquidity in the country, the world's fourth-largest remittance recipient. A little over a year ago the BSP clamped down on the use of e-wallet apps for gambling, requiring supervised institutions to cut in-app access to gambling sites; several gambling entities then migrated to Coins.ph, according to the sources, which also gave them access to crypto and stablecoins for paying offshore partners, according to a third person. Several high-profile compliance staff left the exchange this year, including chief compliance officer Lexi Herrera, AML transaction monitoring head Chris Beaño and money laundering reporting officer Irish Calagui.
metadata.background_zh: Coins.ph 是菲律宾最早的加密货币钱包和交易所之一，24小时现货交易量约为5000万美元，据称控制着该国约75%-80%的比索兑稳定币流动性；菲律宾是全球第四大汇款接收国。大约一年多前，BSP 收紧了对电子钱包应用用于赌博的管制，要求受其监管的机构切断应用内访问赌博网站的通道；据消息人士称，此后若干赌博实体迁移至 Coins.ph，而第三位知情人士表示，这也让这些公司获得加密货币和稳定币渠道，用于向离岸合作方付款。今年，该交易所多位知名合规人员离职，包括首席合规官 Lexi Herrera、反洗钱交易监控负责人 Chris Beaño 以及洗钱报告官 Irish Calagui。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Coins.ph, the largest crypto exchange in the Philippines with over 18 million customers, is reportedly facing punitive action from the country's central bank, Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), over alleged servicing of restricted offshore gambling operators, according to two people with knowledge of the situation. One of those people said the infractions are serious enough that the 12-year-old company could be stripped of its license to operate, and at the start of this month the BSP reportedly imposed restrictions on deposits made through Coins.ph's main wallet firm, DCPay Philippines.

One of the people said losing the license would cause "an earthquake" in the Philippines' crypto ecosystem, given the exchange's scale. Coins.ph says user funds are safe, that it remains a BSP-licensed institution and that it expects to fully restore affected services soon.

The deposit restriction was reportedly not time-bound and no reason was given, unlike temporary suspensions typically imposed over throughput or latency failures, one person said. Coins.ph said it "firmly denies any claim that it knowingly serves offshore gaming or gambling operators" and that it holds itself to BSP, AMLC and other regulatory standards; the BSP had not responded to requests for comment.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
据两位知情人士透露，拥有超过1800万用户的菲律宾最大加密货币交易所 Coins.ph 据称正面临该国央行——菲律宾中央银行（BSP）的惩罚性行动，事由是指控其服务于受限制的离岸赌博运营商。其中一位人士表示，相关违规行为的严重程度足以让这家成立12年的公司被吊销经营牌照；据称本月初 BSP 已对通过 Coins.ph 主要钱包公司 DCPay Philippines 进行的存款施加了限制。

其中一位消息人士称，鉴于 Coins.ph 的体量，一旦被吊销牌照将对菲律宾加密货币生态造成“地震级”冲击。Coins.ph 回应称用户资金安全，公司仍是 BSP 持牌机构，并预计很快全面恢复受影响的服务。

一位人士称，此次存款限制据称没有期限，且未给出理由，这与通常因吞吐量或延迟不达标而施加的临时暂停不同。Coins.ph 表示“坚决否认任何关于其明知故犯地为离岸博彩或赌博运营商提供服务的说法”，并称公司遵守 BSP、反洗钱委员会（AMLC）等监管机构的要求与标准；BSP 尚未回应置评请求。

items.ai_summary: Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury firm SkyAI has offloaded roughly 1.75M SOL (~$175M) since early October, cutting holdings ~70% and crystallizing large losses, while 9.99% holder Bastion Trading is demanding full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price before supporting the company's cash offer.
items.author: theblockbeats

metadata.background_en: Digital asset treasury (DAT) companies hold crypto on their balance sheets as a listed-market vehicle, and the Solana segment has seen intensifying accumulation, with firms such as Forward Industries and DFDV reporting multi-million SOL positions. SkyAI's situation centers on how a listed treasury vehicle discloses and executes sales of its core reserve, and on the Form 8-K, the SEC filing companies use to report major events to shareholders.
metadata.background_zh: 数字资产储备型公司（DAT）以持币作为上市公司资产，Solana 板块的储备积累竞争近期加剧，Forward Industries、DFDV 等公司均公布过数百万枚 SOL 的持仓。SkyAI 此次事件的核心，在于上市储备型公司如何披露和执行其核心储备的出售，以及 Form 8-K 这一用于向股东报告重大事件的 SEC 申报文件。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury company SkyAI has transferred out roughly 1.57 million SOL (~$175 million) since early October and has disclosed selling 1 million SOL (~$107 million), with a Form 8-K dated October 13 showing SOL holdings down to about 600,000 — roughly 70% below the "more than 2 million" figure it cited in mid-September. On October 14, 9.99% shareholder Bastion Trading said it will not participate in SkyAI's October 11 cash tender offer until its concerns are addressed, demanding full disclosure of the SOL disposals, an independent review, board changes, and a tender price of at least $3.50 per share instead of $3.00.

A listed Solana treasury company cutting its holdings by about 70% while crystallizing disclosed losses above $160 million, and a near-10% shareholder publicly contesting the buyout, put both the disclosure practices and board accountability of listed crypto-treasury vehicles in question.

On-chain data cited in the report indicates an average purchase price of about $194 per SOL, implying unrealized/realized losses above $160 million, and SkyAI has said it may continue selling. Bastion Trading also said that at the company's annual shareholder meeting, all five incumbent directors received far more abstentions than votes in favor, some approaching three to one, and questioned whether the board still has a shareholder mandate to sell core reserves and pursue the tender offer.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
纳斯达克上市公司 SkyAI 自 10 月以来已转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），并已披露出售 100 万枚 SOL（约 1.07 亿美元）；10 月 13 日的 Form 8-K 显示其 SOL 持仓已降至约 60 万枚，较 9 月中旬披露的「逾 200 万枚」减少约七成。10 月 14 日，持股约 9.99% 的股东 Bastion Trading 表示，在相关关切获得妥善回应前不会参与 SkyAI 于 10 月 11 日宣布的现金要约收购，并要求全面披露 SOL 处置细节、启动独立审查、改组董事会，以及将要约价由每股 3.00 美元提高至至少 3.50 美元。

一家以 Solana 为储备资产的上市公司将持仓削减约七成并确认逾 1.6 亿美元亏损，同时一名持股接近 10% 的股东公开质疑该要约收购，使上市加密储备型公司的信息披露与董事会问责同时受到质疑。

报道引用的链上数据显示其平均买入价约 194 美元，按近期价格估算浮亏逾 1.6 亿美元，且 SkyAI 表示可能继续出售。Bastion Trading 还指出，在公司年度股东大会上，五名现任董事获得的弃权票均远多于赞成票，部分接近三比一，并质疑现任董事会在失去股东信任后是否仍有授权出售核心储备并推进要约收购。
metadata.market_impact_en: The disposal places roughly 1.57 million SOL of previously treasury-held supply into the market, a direct channel to SOL liquidity and supply. The contested tender offer also bears on the premium-to-NAV and financing capacity of listed SOL treasury vehicles, which can transmit to sentiment across the DAT segment.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次处置将约 157 万枚此前由公司金库持有的 SOL 投放至市场，构成对 SOL 流动性与供给的直接渠道。被质疑的要约收购还关系到上市 SOL 储备型公司的溢价水平与融资能力，并可能通过情绪渠道传导至整个 DAT 板块。

items.ai_summary: Polygon Labs completed its acquisition of Coinme, making its Open Money Stack a US-regulated payments platform that supports USD inflows via bank, card, or cash deposits for on-chain settlement, with clients including Tazapay, Mesh, Toku, and Kira.
items.author: foresightnews

metadata.background_en: Polygon's Open Money Stack is described by Polygon Labs as a vertically integrated suite of on-chain payment solutions spanning blockchain rails, stablecoin orchestration, wallet infrastructure, on-ramps and off-ramps, interoperability, compliance, and on-chain identity. Coinme is a licensed and regulated digital currency exchange and Bitcoin kiosk operator, which adds cash-based access points. Money transmitter licenses are state-issued permissions required to transmit funds on behalf of customers, while FinCEN registration is a federal money services business registration.
metadata.background_zh: Polygon Labs 将 Open Money Stack 描述为一套垂直整合的链上支付解决方案，涵盖区块链底层、稳定币调度、钱包基础设施、入金与出金、互操作性、合规及链上身份等环节。Coinme 是一家持牌并受监管的数字货币交易所和比特币自助终端运营商，可提供现金入口。货币转账牌照是州级颁发的、代表可代客户转移资金的许可，FinCEN 注册则是联邦层面的货币服务业务登记。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Polygon Labs has completed its acquisition of Coinme, and its Open Money Stack is now a US-regulated payments platform that supports USD inflows via bank transfer, card, or cash deposits for on-chain settlement. Named clients include Tazapay, Mesh, Toku, and Kira.

The deal folds regulated US money-transmission capability into Polygon's payments stack, giving the Open Money Stack a fiat on-ramp channel through which bank, card, or cash dollars can be moved on-chain for settlement.

BlockBeats reported that the platform covers 48 US states, holds 37 state-level money transmitter licenses plus 11 applicable exemptions, and is registered with FinCEN as a money services business; the first customers use it for cross-border business payments, account top-ups, global payroll, and USD services.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Polygon Labs 已完成对 Coinme 的收购，其 Open Money Stack 由此成为受美国监管的支付平台，支持美元通过银行、银行卡或现金存款流入，并在链上转移到最终支付场景。目前公布的客户包括 Tazapay、Mesh、Toku 和 Kira。

这笔交易把受美国监管的资金传输能力并入 Polygon 的支付体系，使 Open Money Stack 具备法币入金通道，可将通过银行、银行卡或现金存入的美元转入链上完成结算。

据 BlockBeats 报道，该平台覆盖美国 48 个州，持有 37 张州级货币转账牌照及 11 项豁免资格，并已在 FinCEN 注册为货币服务业务机构；首批客户将其用于跨境商业支付、账户充值、全球薪酬发放和美元相关服务。
metadata.market_impact_en: The acquisition gives fiat on-ramp and off-ramp infrastructure with US state licensing a direct connection to Polygon-based stablecoin and payment flows, so the channel most affected is regulatory and custody access for payments firms and their USD on-chain settlement, rather than a change in protocol mechanics or token supply. Exposure concentrates in stablecoin rails and payment-focused applications built on Polygon that rely on regulated fiat conversion.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次收购让具备美国州级牌照的法币入金与出金基础设施与基于 Polygon 的稳定币及支付流程直接打通，因此受影响最明显的渠道是支付企业所面对的监管与托管准入，以及其美元链上结算路径，而非协议机制或代币供给的变化。相关敞口集中于依赖合规法币兑换的稳定币通道和构建在 Polygon 上的支付类应用。

metadata.background_en: Evernorth came to the public market through a SPAC merger, reported to be with Armada Acquisition Corp II, and is backed by Ripple; search results describe a planned Nasdaq listing under the ticker XRPN alongside the 473 million XRP and $300 million in cash. The XRP Ledger's Lending Protocol (XLS-66) is an on-chain primitive that enables fixed-term, uncollateralized loans funded from a pooled single-asset vault, the DeFi venue Evernorth says it will expand into.

The company said it will later expand into lending on the XRP Ledger and on-chain DeFi strategies, with the deployment led by former Coinbase Asset Management co-CIO Hugo Jeandesboz.

A publicly listed treasury company is naming regulated exchanges and custodians to actively put a nine-figure XRP reserve to work rather than simply holding it, which ties a large XRP position into established institutional custody and trading venues.

The plan is a stated intention to deploy from the fourth quarter onward, not a completed deployment. The 473 million XRP figure is valued at approximately $648 million at current prices, and the XRP Ledger lending and on-chain DeFi expansion is described as a future step.

items.ai_summary: Kraken's parent company is set to acquire a European bank, extending the exchange's push into regulated banking and fiat infrastructure in Europe.
items.author: Financial Times

metadata.background_en: Kraken is a US-based cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2011, and per Wikipedia it was the first crypto company to obtain a bank charter. Payward has been pushing into regulated financial infrastructure: it has applied for a US national trust bank charter, and CoinDesk reported in July that Kraken was seeking a banking license in Lithuania. Payward co-CEO Arjun Sethi said a regulated EU bank "is the piece that lets us serve European clients the way a primary financial institution should: one place to hold assets, move them freely, and put them to work."
metadata.background_zh: Kraken 是一家成立于 2011 年的美国加密货币交易所，据维基百科介绍，它是首家获得银行牌照的加密公司。Payward 一直在推进受监管金融基础设施布局：它已申请美国的 national trust bank 牌照，CoinDesk 在 7 月报道称 Kraken 正在争取立陶宛的银行牌照。Payward 联合首席执行官 Arjun Sethi 表示，一家受监管的欧盟银行“让我们能够像主要金融机构那样服务欧洲客户：一个可以持有资产、自由转移资产并让资产产生收益的地方”。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank for an undisclosed amount, a deal that would give it a European Union banking license. The acquisition is subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close in 2027.

The deal would let Payward offer EU customers interest-bearing deposits, loans, card services and euro payments, expanding it beyond crypto trading, and would make it the first crypto firm to buy a European bank, according to the Financial Times.

Saldo Bank had €163.9 million (about $180 million) in total assets at the end of 2025, up 22.7% year over year, and is licensed in Lithuania, Finland, Sweden and Germany with a passport to operate in the Netherlands; it offers deposits, consumer and business loans and payment services. Payward said its banking business has already originated more than $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an electronic money institution license in Ireland.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
加密货币交易所 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 已达成协议，将以未披露的金额收购总部位于立陶宛的 Saldo Bank，这笔交易将使其获得欧盟银行牌照。该收购仍需监管批准，预计于 2027 年完成。

据《金融时报》报道，该交易将使 Payward 能够为欧盟客户提供计息存款、贷款、银行卡服务和欧元支付，从而把业务从加密货币交易扩展到传统金融服务，并使其成为首家收购欧洲银行的加密公司。

截至 2025 年底，Saldo Bank 的总资产为 1.639 亿欧元（约 1.8 亿美元），同比增长 22.7%；该行在立陶宛、芬兰、瑞典和德国持有牌照，并拥有在荷兰运营的通行证，提供存款、个人及企业贷款和支付服务。Payward 表示，其银行业务已发放超过 20 亿美元贷款，并持有美联储有限用途主账户以及爱尔兰的电子货币机构牌照。
metadata.market_impact_en: The transaction channels crypto-native capital directly into EU-regulated banking infrastructure, giving Payward control of deposit-taking, lending and euro payment rails that compete with traditional lenders serving EU crypto users. The main exposure runs through EU-facing exchanges, custody and payments providers whose fiat on/off-ramp and yield products would face a licensed banking competitor, with the deal's 2027 closing and regulatory approval still pending.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易把加密行业的资金直接引入受欧盟监管的银行基础设施，使 Payward 掌握吸收存款、放贷和欧元支付通道，与面向欧盟加密用户的传统银行形成竞争。主要影响传导至面向欧盟市场的交易所、托管与支付服务商——其法币出入金和收益类产品将面对一家持牌银行的竞争；同时该交易预计 2027 年完成，并仍待监管批准。

items.ai_summary: Ledger ordered distributors in six Southeast Asian countries plus Hong Kong to halt sales and remove hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates suspected device tampering linked to reported user crypto thefts.
items.author: theblockbeats

metadata.background_en: The investigation was disclosed on Oct 9 after users reported crypto asset thefts linked to Ledger devices bought through CryptoBilis, a reseller in the region; Ledger has said all confirmed losses involve devices sold through that reseller. Ledger said the only confirmed incidents remain contained in Southeast Asia and that it has not verified a drain linked to a device bought elsewhere. It added that it has no indication its own infrastructure, systems, services or direct sales channel have been compromised. Researchers have reported the implant in Ledger X devices since Sept 16, with tampered units offered at nearly half the original price.
metadata.background_zh: 相关调查于 10 月 9 日公开，此前有用户报告称，通过区域经销商 CryptoBilis 购买的 Ledger 设备涉及加密资产被盗；Ledger 表示所有已确认的损失都涉及通过该经销商售出的设备。Ledger 称目前确认的相关事件仍局限于东南亚，尚未核实其他地区购买的设备与资金被盗有关。该公司还强调，没有迹象表明其自身基础设施、系统、服务或官方直销渠道遭到入侵。研究人员称，自 9 月 16 日起已发现 Ledger X 设备中被植入该装置，被篡改的设备以近原价一半的价格出售。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Ledger asked resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and take its hardware wallets off the shelves while it investigates suspected device tampering, the company said in a post on X on Tuesday. The request expands earlier stop-sale and shipment-suspension measures against regional reseller CryptoBilis, an investigation made public on Oct 9.

The move removes Ledger devices from retail shelves across a region and puts the integrity of the hardware-wallet supply chain, a core assumption of self-custody, under scrutiny. In Germany, MediaMarkt Saturn stopped selling Ledger devices in stores and online with Ledger's agreement after a customer reported an implant, though no funds were lost.

Ledger's Donjon security team found the implant reads the 24-word recovery phrase from the device's screen during setup and sends it out over LTE; anyone holding that phrase can restore the wallet and move its funds. Onchain investigator Specter has traced more than $86 million in suspected thefts, a figure Ledger says it has not verified.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Ledger 于周二表示，已要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售，并将相关硬件钱包撤下货架，以调查疑似遭篡改的设备。此次要求扩大了此前针对区域经销商 CryptoBilis 采取的停售及暂停发货措施，相关调查于 10 月 9 日公开。

此举使 Ledger 设备在东南亚及香港的零售货架上被撤下，并使硬件钱包供应链的完整性——自托管安全的核心前提——受到审视。在德国，MediaMarkt Saturn 已在 Ledger 同意下停止在门店和线上销售其设备，此前一名客户报告发现植入装置，不过未造成资金损失。

Ledger 的 Donjon 安全团队发现，该植入装置会在设备初始化过程中从屏幕上读取 24 个单词的助记词，并通过 LTE 外传；任何持有该助记词的人都可以恢复钱包并转走资金。链上调查者 Specter 追踪到超过 8600 万美元的疑似被盗资金，Ledger 表示该数字尚未经其核实。
metadata.market_impact_en: The disruption sits in the physical retail and reseller channel for Ledger devices in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, so the transmission runs through supply-chain integrity and self-custody sentiment rather than protocol liquidity. Ledger says its direct sales channel is unaffected, while rival Trezor's stated plan to end reseller authorizations from Jan 1, 2027 as a precautionary measure could shift hardware-wallet demand between vendors and sales channels.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此次影响集中在 Ledger 设备在东南亚及香港的线下零售与经销渠道，传导路径主要作用于供应链完整性和自托管信心，而非协议流动性。Ledger 称其官方直销渠道未受影响；与此同时，竞争对手 Trezor 表示出于预防将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日终止对经销商的授权，这可能使硬件钱包需求在不同厂商和销售渠道之间发生转移。
